colleges.name: IIM Ahmedabad
colleges.notes: Two-stage process. Shortlisting is 65% CAT + 35% Application Rating (academics/work-ex/diversity). Final offer weighs PI heavily. Weightages change yearly - verify before relying on this.

colleges.name: Indian School of Business (ISB)
colleges.notes: ISB does not publish fixed percentages - evaluation is holistic across Academic Credentials, Leadership Potential, and Personal Attributes. These numbers are an approximation based on typical admit profiles, not official weightage.

colleges.name: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS) Delhi
colleges.notes: Academics split as 10% Class X + 10% Class XII. Additional bonus marks awarded to women candidates.

colleges.name: XLRI Jamshedpur
colleges.notes: The 15% bucket covers academic profile, work experience, general knowledge, and essay writing combined - XLRI does not break this down further publicly.
